title.narrative: Provision of Life-Saving Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) and Gender Based Violence (GBV) Prevention, Response and Support Services for the most vulnerable women and adolescent girls in prioritized areas

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to respond to the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) and gender-based violence (GBV) needs of the most affected and vulnerable populations, including women and adolescents, and survivors of sexual violence through life-saving assistance in crisis-hit communities. This UNFPA project provides clinical delivery assistance reusable equipment, clinical delivery assistance drugs and disposable equipment, and specific commodities for delivery care, among other activities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 27,528 people, including 21,500 women, 3,810 men, 2,218 children, and 275 persons with disabilities.
